description: This is a unit test class for DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.gateway.security.authentication package. It tests the aggregation of authentication failure results, handling of exceptions, and the merging of headers.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultAuthenticationFailureAggregator, verifying correct behavior for aggregating authentication failure results and exception handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the aggregator instance before each test.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWithEmptyList
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown when an empty list is provided.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWithoutDittoRuntimeExceptions
methods.description: Tests that an exception is thrown if the failure results do not contain DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWitNestedDittoRuntimeExceptionWithoutDescription
methods.description: Tests behavior when a nested DittoRuntimeException lacks a description.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWitNestedDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Verifies that a nested DittoRuntimeException is correctly aggregated and returned.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailures
methods.description: Tests successful aggregation of multiple failure results, merging headers, and returning a composite exception.

methods.name: aggregateAuthenticationFailuresWithExceptionNotUnauthorized
methods.description: Ensures that when exceptions of different status codes are present, the one with the UNAUTHORIZED status is prioritized.
